subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should CodexBar support the new opt-in Model activity share-card style alongside the established Summary card?
rationale: The implementation now avoids replacing the existing default, but accepting a second long-lived share-card narrative and selector is a product-surface decision that source inspection cannot make.

options.title: Approve the opt-in activity card
options.body: Accept the additional style after current-head bundle proof confirms the selector and all export actions stay synchronized.

options.title: Keep the summary-only contract
options.body: Decline the additional share-card mode and retain the current summary artifact as the sole supported workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in activity card
recommendation.body: Accept the additional style after current-head bundle proof confirms the selector and all export actions stay synchronized.

likelyOwner.reason: The owner has supplied the visual/product context and recent merged work for this sharing and Usage & Spend area.
